title: Beacons
description: Create named, colored waypoint beams in the world and share them with other players directly in chat.
body:
# Beacons
Mark important spots with tall, colored beacon beams and share them with friends. Great for bases, farms, mining spots, and meetups.

## Features
- Create named, colored waypoint beams with a command
- In-world beam plus a label and distance
- Share a waypoint in chat; others with the mod can import it with a click
- Optional expiry for temporary markers

## How to use
/beacon add <name> at your location, /beacon list to manage, /beacon share <name> to send it to others.

Client-side. Requires Fabric API and Yet Another Config Lib (YACL).
